software_class: desktop application with local OS integration and offline behavior

options.name: Native desktop application
options.when_to_use: OS integration, performance, or native UX is important.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when web delivery is sufficient.
options.rationale: Fits platform behavior and local resources.

options.name: Hybrid desktop application
options.when_to_use: Web UI reuse matters while desktop packaging is required.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when native performance or small footprint dominates.

options.name: Local-first desktop application
options.when_to_use: User data should remain primarily local.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when collaboration and centralized state dominate.
options.tradeoffs: Sync is optional but complex if added.
options.risks: Backup and migration need explicit design.
